gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-inter-tight: Wobbly, rope-like lettering up top, with bowls nearly sealed. Inter Tight follows in sans-serif form, short ascenders and held-back curve tails, so a long passage moves briskly after the heading's leisurely stroll.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-karla: Jelly Crazies draws a thread of ink with no swelling. Karla's stocky, tall-bodied sans and gaping c give it open ground to bounce against, so the closed, wobbly heading and the relaxed text feel like playmates.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-kedebideri: Kedebideri reads tall and friendly, its rounded plain sans letters staying open and inviting from line to line. Under Jelly Crazies, whose bowls nearly seal, a longer passage drifts along easily.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-khula: Playful is the mood Jelly Crazies sets, with wobbly bowls that nearly close up. And Khula, a sans with a brush-belly midsection and curves holding their mouths open, makes the strongest quality here the closed-versus-open contrast.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-krub: Krub carries the text in a plain sans with a pronounced x-height and pen-lifted curves left unfinished. And its open shapes make the pair's strongest quality plain: Jelly Crazies, a flat, unswelling line, nearly seals its bowls shut.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-kufam: Kufam reads like a neon tube, one track width with open e curves. Jelly Crazies wobbles above that plain sans, its nearly sealed bowls meeting body letters that dominate the line.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-lexend: Approachable is Lexend's manner, with outsized lowercase and open jaws on every curve, set under Jelly Crazies' wobbly, nearly shut bowls. Closed against open is the strongest quality.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-lexend-deca: Lexend Deca reads plain and unshaded, with big lowercase and terminals that stop short of curling back. Its open sans-serif forms are the strongest quality against Jelly Crazies, whose bowls nearly seal shut.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-liter: Liter brings a sans with no stroke contrast, great vertical presence and wide mouths on round forms beneath Jelly Crazies. Closed bowls against open ones is the strongest quality.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-mada: True monoline drawing is the heading's signature, a wobbly Jelly Crazies line with bowls nearly sealed. Mada brings a towering midzone and curves that refuse to close, a plain sans that gives text room.
